name: Infinity Mirror Implementation Packet
purpose: Make the Infinity Mirror experience implementation-ready for a future React/Next migration without weakening the current static, semantic, proof-first route.
non_clone_boundary: The Anthropic 81K Interviews experience is used only as a research and interaction-pattern reference. The Unwind implementation uses its own visual language: infinity, reflection, brain cells, proof gates, organism routes, and human authority.

current_stack_gate.current_site: Vite plus semantic HTML, CSS, and dependency-free JavaScript.
current_stack_gate.install_command_when_migration_is_approv: npm install next react react-dom framer-motion gsap three tailwindcss @tailwindcss/postcss
current_stack_gate.reason: The public route already proves the story with semantic HTML, SVG, CSS, and bounded requestAnimationFrame islands. Motion libraries should enter only as isolated leaf runtimes during a planned React/Next migration.

remix_design_concept_review.concept: Persistent mirror shell with a visible growth-stage meter.
remix_design_concept_review.site_translation: Keep the route anchored around a durable mirror shell, proof stages, explicit growth gates, and a visible MirrorShellSpecimen instead of treating the portal as a one-time hero decoration.
remix_design_concept_review.boundary: Growth stages describe proof maturity, not user destiny or identity truth.

remix_design_concept_review.concept: Quiet prompt chamber with gentle prompt, Socratic challenge, pattern reflection, and future-self prompts.
remix_design_concept_review.site_translation: Translate prompts into proof-path questions that help builders, users, investors, and collaborators pick a next route without pressure.
remix_design_concept_review.boundary: Prompts may invite reflection; they do not provide therapy, diagnosis, or hidden profiling.

remix_design_concept_review.concept: Returned artifact as an object the user can keep, correct, deepen, or close.
remix_design_concept_review.site_translation: Keep the returned artifact specimen and repair ledger as the strongest product metaphor: every reflection returns as reviewable evidence before memory or motion accepts it.
remix_design_concept_review.boundary: The artifact is a review packet, not a final authority or public broadcast.

remix_design_concept_review.concept: Scroll descent engine that moves from self to memory, split, lattice, current, evolution, and return.
remix_design_concept_review.site_translation: Use the current dependency-free canvas field as the proof baseline, then move deeper descent motion into optional GSAP or Three leaf components only after migration approval.
remix_design_concept_review.boundary: The cinematic field remains decorative; semantic HTML owns meaning.

remix_design_concept_review.site_translation: Expose memory geography as inspectable proof maps and organism routes, not as hidden personalization.
remix_design_concept_review.boundary: No hidden memory map, camera intake, or sensitive inference ships without explicit consent and proof.

remix_design_concept_review.site_translation: Replace birth-date identity claims with reversible lenses such as Architect, Cartographer, Translator, and Ritualist.
remix_design_concept_review.boundary: The system can offer a lens; it cannot claim identity truth.

phase_coverage.proof_rule: Expose a source-backed long-form audit plus ten visible reverse-engineering lenses with purpose, why it works, and Unwind reinterpretation before citing source scale, method, tensions, delivery gaps, choreography, emotional progression, and non-clone boundary. Translate Anthropic desire categories and emotional journey beats into organism routes, proof gates, and authority stops without copying participant quotes, inventing personas, or profiling emotion.
The infinity mark is a portal and threshold, not decoration.

phase_coverage.current_site_surface: Mirror, Reflection, Brain, Organisms, Recursive Growth, #mirror-cognitive-evolution-trace, Proof, #mirror-authority-gradient, Join Evolution, #mirror-evolution-entry-protocol, and #mirror-phase-proof-ledger
phase_coverage.proof_rule: Every chapter must have semantic headings, route links, and a proof or authority boundary.
The scroll choreography map names seven story acts with focus, motion, and proof return before the motion contract names trigger, animation, timing, duration, easing, and performance strategy.

phase_coverage.proof_rule: The infinity mark can act as portal, navigator, tunnel, organism visualizer, and doorway only when route, proof, and boundary remain semantic HTML outside SVG, canvas, or WebGL.
Component tree, architecture, assets, design tokens, accessibility, mobile, SEO, and rollout gates stay inspectable.
Future React, Framer, GSAP, Three/WebGL, Tailwind, and asset code paths are separated into leaf contracts with cleanup, fallbacks, mobile shutdown, stop conditions, and depth readiness gates.

react_next_architecture.server_rule: The page and all meaning-bearing chapters render as server components first.
react_next_architecture.client_rule: Only motion islands use 'use client'. No critical copy, proof claim, CTA, route, or status label depends on hydration.
react_next_architecture.metadata_rule: Next metadata must mirror the current title, description, canonical, OpenGraph image, ImageObject schema, llms.txt, ai-services.json, sitemap, and asset manifest entries.
page_contract: Render each chapter from typed data.
Render proof routes as real anchors.
Mount Framer, GSAP, and Three islands after semantic content.
Disable motion islands for reduced motion and compact screens.

motion_architecture.owns: Current production route: portal pulse, story rail, proof cards, semantic fallback graphics.
motion_architecture.trigger: Page load, viewport entry, hash navigation.
motion_architecture.animation: Opacity, transform, SVG line draw, low-cost ambient scan.
motion_architecture.duration: 240ms to 1.2s reveal states; 5.8s to 13s ambient loops.
motion_architecture.easing: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for reveals; ease-in-out for ambient loops.
motion_architecture.performance: Transform and opacity only. No layout animation. Reduced-motion freezes to semantic sections.
motion_architecture.fallback: Static HTML and SVG remain readable.

motion_architecture.owns: Chapter reveals, lens swaps, route-card microinteractions, shared active states.
motion_architecture.animation: Staggered cell reveal, active lens layout state, tactile route-card state.
motion_architecture.easing: spring stiffness 100 damping 20, or cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for non-spring reveals.
motion_architecture.performance: Isolated client leaf. No global scroll listener. No parent rerender loop.
motion_architecture.fallback: Semantic list and buttons remain visible without Framer.

motion_architecture.owns: Optional pinned desktop portal fracture sequence only.
motion_architecture.trigger: Desktop viewport, reduced-motion false, approved migration.
motion_architecture.animation: Pinned portal scale, mirror plane reveal, shard split, brain-cell wake.
motion_architecture.duration: Scrubbed across roughly 520 percent scroll distance.
motion_architecture.easing: ScrollTrigger scrub with transform-only state changes.
motion_architecture.performance: One timeline in one client component, gsap.context cleanup, no mobile pinning.

motion_architecture.owns: Optional desktop recursive brain tunnel and depth particles.
motion_architecture.trigger: Desktop viewport, visible canvas, reduced-motion false.
motion_architecture.animation: Instanced lemniscate particles, slow depth rotation, proof nodes surfacing.
motion_architecture.duration: 60fps target, DPR capped at 1.5, pauses offscreen.
motion_architecture.easing: Shader time easing; camera and group transforms only.
motion_architecture.performance: Dispose renderer, geometry, material, and RAF on cleanup. Disable under 900px.
